I  really wanted to like the DudeRobe, especially because it was advertised as a comfortable, warm robe that could also double as a bathrobe. The idea of having two robes in one was what initially attracted me to the product.

 Unfortunately, after using it for about two weeks, I found that it doesn't perform very well as a bathrobe. The towel-like material on the inside simply isn't thick or absorbent enough to dry your body effectively. My biggest issue, however, is the design of the outer material. When you try to dry yourself, the outer fabric slides back and forth over the inner towel layer, preventing you from applying the friction needed to properly dry your skin like you would with a traditional bath towel or bathrobe.

 There are definitely some things I like about it. The hood is a nice addition, and I appreciate that the belt is attached so you don't have to worry about losing it. It's also comfortable to wear as a regular robe.

 However, I think marketing it as a two-in-one robe is misleading because it doesn't effectively serve both purposes. At this point, I'm using it strictly as a regular robe and have kept my old bathrobe for drying off after showers.

 Considering the premium price, I expected more functionality. If you're looking for a comfortable lounge robe, it may be worth considering. But if you're purchasing it specifically for its advertised dual-purpose design, I think you'll be disappointed. Ultimately, I paid a premium price for what has turned out to be just a regular robe.
reviews.title: Great Concept, but Falls Short as a Two-in-One Bathrobe

I want to love this, but I mostly just like it. I’ve been looking for a robe with sleeve cuffs for a long time and was waiting for the female version of the dude robe to come out. 

 Pros: 
 - sleeve cuffs. Although they sleeves are too long for me, so I roll them over once. But they stay rolled up so thats fine. 
 - Material of the robe is really nice. I can put it on after a shower and it actually absorbs water. 

 Cons:
 - I hate the hood. But I don’t like hoodies. It makes the robe feel really heavy and it pulls apart the front. I’ve considered cutting the hood off
 - it doesn’t stay tied shut. For anything. There is an internal tie on one side. But the outside tie is secured near the waist on each side so there isn’t anything to hold the outside in place. I’ve considered sewing on some type of snap or toggle. 
 - I wish there was a slightly longer version
